prompt: A South Wales valley: long terraces of houses stepping up the hillside with their windows boarded, and above them the whole green hillside up to the old pit head is dotted with tents and smoke, people walking up the path with water. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
